entries.mem0ai/mem0: A universal memory layer and official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud or self-hosted OSS. It features multi-level state management for users and sessions using hybrid semantic, keyword, and entity matching with time-aware retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication for high-efficiency recall. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance with connectors for Notion, GitHub, and Google Workspace.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent provider that uses a filesystem paradigm and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token costs. It significantly improves task completion rates and provides visualized retrieval trajectories for debugging context logic.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that synthesizes cited answers across complex ideas and entities. It utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph to extract typed relationships without LLM calls and runs background cycles for memory consolidation.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A learning-based memory system implementing retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term agent intelligence. It offers easy integration via LLM wrappers and supports Docker-based deployment with dedicated client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A stateful agent library that asynchronously extracts reasoning-based conclusions from conversations and events. It tracks evolving entities like users and ideas, providing prompt-ready context through Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent provider that treats memory as a git repository, enabling version control via branching and merging of markdown context trees. It delivers sub-100ms access through a high-speed 5-tier retrieval system.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents featuring SQLite-backed storage for sub-millisecond performance. It supports episodic compression and temporal knowledge graphs via MCP, CLI, and Python SDK.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving harness that distills successful agent strategies into reusable playbooks. It generates structured traces and artifacts to help agents succeed on complex tasks across various local and cloud LLM runtimes.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin utilizing a DAG-based engine to ensure no message is ever lost. It combines SQLite storage for raw messages with hierarchical summaries and dedicated tools for targeted recall.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for the Honcho library that enables private, cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible provider and includes automated setup scripts for PostgreSQL and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems utilizing an open YAML engram format for human-readable storage. It supports hierarchical scoping for global or project-specific knowledge and integrates with MCP tools like Claude Code.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and memory layer providing portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It uses SQLite for secure custody and includes tools to manually edit, delete, or reclassify context.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that eliminates cloud dependencies through a local-first architecture. It employs hybrid retrieval using BM25, vector search, and multi-graph traversal via MCP server plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization tool that increases cache hits by 4–12× through prefix reordering and deduplication. It reduces input tokens by approximately 36% for long-context workloads in SGLang, vLLM, and Hermes Agent.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: An embedded, self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable retrieval via 'why_retrieved' tags. It features first-class contradiction tracking and canonicalization of duplicates without requiring a separate server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that consolidates temporal continuity, graph truth, and corpus retrieval. It utilizes a multi-layered storage approach with SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide bounded evidence packing.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses local-first storage with SQLite-vec and GGUF models, operating as an MCP-native server.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system that indexes files and codebases using automated summarization and tagging. It employs edge tags for navigable relationships and tracks agent intentions through reflective skill instructions.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A utility that reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking for tool selection. It includes a dashboard to track schema token savings and is compatible with native Hermes tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using an embedded .lbdb graph database with importance-weighted recall. It surfaces high-priority memories first and supports BM25 search and GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that ensures complete deletion of memories without leaving residual summaries. It provides transparency through a trace.jsonl audit log of all memory operations.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A durable cross-session memory provider featuring semantic search and provenance tracking. It automatically mirrors native Hermes memory tools and supports session snapshots with TTL settings.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools for manual storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that enables Hermes Agent to generate prototypes, motion graphics, and decks. It integrates with over 150 design systems and 22 local CLIs to bridge the gap between design and code.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A comprehensive library of 817 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to major industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It provides agents with specialized knowledge for security auditing and financial fraud detection.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows Hermes Agent to generate editable .drawio diagrams from natural language prompts. It is particularly useful for visualizing codebase structures across Python, JS, Go, and Rust using a vast library of cloud and AI logos.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that enables skills to evolve collectively through automatic deduplication and quality improvements. It creates a shared evolution loop to synchronize skill libraries across different agents and team members.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: A content auditing tool that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass rewrite process. It utilizes a tiered replacement table and 49 pattern categories to remove structural and rhythmic AI fingerprints.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library providing thematic skill collections for architecture, UX, and product strategy. These frameworks are based on established industry guidelines and are compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It streamlines development by generating both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, utilizing progressive disclosure to reduce token consumption. It supports both programmatic and filesystem-based skill definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A suite of tools for extracting YouTube transcripts, captions, and timestamps without relying on yt-dlp. It enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches and browse channels and playlists.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and installing skills with ARD v0.9 compliance and urn:air identifiers. It ensures trusted transactions through Ed25519-signed bids and dual settlement rails via Stripe and MPP.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts through the dynamic generation of custom 'analytical lenses.' It includes validated prisms for simulation and optimization, along with a reflection tool to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A specialized workflow that transforms rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It features Lite and Full modes and includes a formal spec review gate for quality evaluation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running agents that uses a durable card model for tracking tasks and decisions. It features local-first storage for easy diff reviews and mandatory QA gates to verify work before completion.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Implements literate programming by weaving source code and documentation into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable code and automatically syncs edits between the source and the documentation.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A self-memory system that captures high-value decisions in markdown files for cross-instance sharing. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on captured work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Provides agentskills.io compliant tools for interacting with the Chainlink oracle network. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams, installable via the Vercel skills CLI.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Converts repositories and documentation into agentskills.io-compliant skills using AST analysis. It ensures accuracy by linking every instruction directly to specific source code line numbers.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: The official skill set for FLUX image generation, providing standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2. It includes API integration patterns for webhooks and precise hex color specifications.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills featuring an OpenAPI-driven CLI for lifecycle management. It supports recursive dependency resolution and integrated monetization via TON and Stripe.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Enables the autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token usage for large toolsets. It maintains persistent connections to multiple MCP servers via a socket-based daemon.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Integrates Hermes Agent with Nextcloud to manage files, calendars, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses secure HTTPS communication and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C#/.NET implementation of the agentskills.io specification with MCP integration. It leverages Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool loading and supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts for various surfaces, including Discord and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model reasoning capabilities and tracks token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles to find bugs. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning without modifying the code.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent swarm that simplifies code by focusing on hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It uses a risk-tiered triage system to safely modify code and detect concurrency anti-patterns.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer retrieval system that uses FTS5, embeddings, and RRF fusion to find the most relevant skills. It integrates via a pre_llm_call hook and degrades gracefully if optional dependencies are missing.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC and various payment protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: Provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes, featuring daily automatic updates for all included tools. Users can easily execute agents like Claude Code or GitHub Copilot via simple nix run commands.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Offers specialized scripts and configuration guides to run agent CLIs on Android smartphones via Termux. It utilizes Termux:API and Termux:GUI to<pad><pad><pad> provide hardware and UI access on ARM64 devices.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop solution that includes a GUI, TTS, and 100 built-in tools across 20 toolsets. It supports local models via LM Studio and features a dynamic tool maker for custom automation pipelines without requiring Docker.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: Features a one-line installation script for rapid deployment of Hermes Agent within a Termux environment. This setup supports over 200 models, including OpenAI and local Ollama instances, to prioritize privacy and low latency.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: An unofficial community Helm chart designed for Kubernetes deployments with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for HERMES_HOME and supports both direct deployment and CRD-based workflows.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using kernel-level enforcement for network, filesystem, and process limits. It allows for dynamic security policies ranging from strict to permissive access while integrating with IDEs and MCP servers.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A streamlined Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for custom builds using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A NixOS module and package for declarative management of agent configurations, documents, and systemd services. It ensures reproducible deployments with secure secrets handling via sops-nix and systemd integration.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers, this project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs with Nous Portal integration.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane that allows users to manage multiple Hermes Agent instances through a single web application. It<pad>provides workspace isolation, hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.ellickjohnson/portainer-stack-hermes: A Docker Compose stack optimized for Portainer deployment that includes an integrated ttyd web terminal. The project features automated image builds driven by GitHub Actions for streamlined management.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables the dispatch and monitoring of multi-agent workflows without external dependencies. It distinguishes itself through real-time WebSocket telemetry and built-in security features like secret detection and trust scoring for every task.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Providing both TUI and web dashboards, this control surface manages Hermes alongside other coding agents across parallel git worktrees and multi-repo workspaces. It prioritizes security by sandboxing agent environments using Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template utilizes a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes from a single VPS agent into automated specialist teams. It comes pre-equipped with specific skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management to streamline infrastructure tasks.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent through a level-based architecture, this framework facilitates seamless task delegation and handoffs between orchestrators and specialists. It focuses on operational reliability with bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and automated backups.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework builds autonomous agent swarms across 23+ LLM providers, featuring durable memory and scheduled execution. It stands out by providing visual org charts to help users map and manage complex agent team hierarchies.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: Acting as a mission control center, this project uses a Kanban-style interface to supervise autonomous Hermes agents from a single screen. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification by live-streaming agent reasoning and requiring manual approval for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents through a master orchestrator to handle research, planning, and implementation. It enforces a rigorous development lifecycle with mandatory reviewer and tester gates for all security and code refactoring tasks.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system integrates MCP and ACP protocols to manage the lifecycle of Leader and Specialist agents. It features a real-time Web UI that combines agent dialogue monitoring with a Kanban flow for local tool and task management.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Focused on meta-optimization, this project uses an automated outer-loop search to evolve and improve agent harness code. It orchestrates benchmark evaluations via Hermes to track performance frontiers through structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This unique arena orchestrates two competing AI companies, each powered by nine autonomous agents, in a race for GitHub stars. It utilizes Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time scoreboard to visualize metrics and agent-to-agent competition.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This tool implements ACP-style delegation to route tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It is designed to prevent context pollution in parent agents while enforcing safety through configurable timeouts and output limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool creates a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph to minimize token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It supports automatic indexing and real-time file syncing, integrating seamlessly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A Rust-based CLI tool designed for high-performance terminal monitoring of token consumption. It provides visualization dashboards to track usage trends across various agents and IDEs, including Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic, system prompts, and tool schemas from agents like Hermes and Cursor. It enables precise debugging by allowing users to compare adjacent requests to identify context changes.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that orchestrates autonomous CTO loops for managing issues and pull requests. It features 23 specialized skills and integrates with Telegram, Slack, and Discord for project control via plain language.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community-driven CLI skins and themes designed to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can apply various aesthetics and ASCII art using YAML-based themes and inheritance-based overrides.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy platform for autonomous agents featuring encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments and supports identity registration with human-readable handles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively without OAuth or external processes and includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM and RL training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built specifically for autonomous agent control through an MCP-compatible interface. It includes human-in-the-loop supervisory controls and maintains durable state via session snapshots and undo capabilities.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and<pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad><pad> de-scoped skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and instructions.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve significant token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research and DevOps, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: A rapid deployment tool that installs the hermes-agent stack along with 12 supporting services and 29 plugins. It offers three scalable deployment tiers ranging from minimum viable setups to full production stacks at zero cost.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter designed to scan AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts without requiring LLM calls. It uses seven structural detectors to identify common failure modes across JSON, YAML, and prompt files.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A specialized migration utility for transitioning from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It automs the mapping of agent personas, memories, and skills, while handling the transfer of credentials from environment files.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that provides a unified interface for Hermes Agent and other CLI agents like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers a single point of control for multiple agent runtimes across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local cowork application that provides a unified GUI for Hermes Agent and over 13 other CLI agents. It features a built-in engine for zero-configuration tasks and can automatically generate editable Word, Excel, and Morph PPT documents.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A lightweight web-based interface built with Python and vanilla JS that maintains full feature parity with the Hermes CLI. It utilizes a three-panel layout to facilitate efficient workspace file browsing from a browser or mobile device.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to simplify the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent. It includes an integrated GUI for managing toolsets, profiles, and sessions across various local and remote AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A comprehensive web dashboard that manages multi-platform AI chat and session analytics. It supports scoped memory and profile management, with integrated configuration for eight different communication channels including Discord, Slack, and Telegram.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a PTY terminal and Monaco editor for full file system access. It introduces Swarm Mode for role-based dispatch using tmux-backed workers alongside an integrated MCP catalog and skills manager.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It offers specialized native views for Kanban boards, cron jobs, and sessions, including an embedded terminal for system repair.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard focusing on the Hermes AI stack's operational health. It features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent pipelines and a control plane for managing the lifecycle of MCP servers.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that provides unified search across multiple AI agent histories. It includes a Quota Meter to track usage limits for Claude and Codex without using remote logging or telemetry.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, specifically tailored for Chinese users. It provides an advanced UI for monitoring tasks and managing both cloud and local model providers.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS interface optimized for Hermes Agent instances running on SSH hosts or Orgo cloud VMs. It enables one-click automated installation on cloud computers and integrates WebRTC voice mode via OpenAI Realtime.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that bridges active browser context with a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime. It captures tab metadata and selected text to sync models, profiles, and persistent chat sessions.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI that renders markdown, LaTeX, and tool calls. It uses Kanban boards to dispatch agentic work and provides terminal-based management of memory and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed as a Telegram Mini App for local execution. It features terminal-style streaming chat and the ability to spawn background agents with live output monitoring.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop GUI that requires no admin rights or Docker. It bundles over 100 tools, including ComfyUI and MusicGen, and includes a dynamic tool maker for creating Python handlers and API wrappers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A self-hosted, glassmorphic web interface delivered as a single-file React 18 HTML application. It integrates real-time log streaming and a terminal for managing AI skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring and configuration dashboard that tracks model distribution and costs via a real-time activity feed. It provides searchable conversation histories using FTS5 and read-only inspection of agent skills and config files.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first interface with tool approval cards and SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and skills, with isolated profile management for API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents via a PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming responses.
